jtl_setup_invalid_cloud: Check the highlighted fields. Enter a connection name, the tenant ID from JTL Cloud, and an access token.
jtl_setup_invalid_onprem: Check the highlighted fields. The API URL must start with https:// and end with /. Enter the token and the challenge code.
jtl_setup_invalid_replace_onprem: Enter the new token and challenge code.
jtl_setup_help_cloud: Use the tenant ID and access token from your JTL Cloud installation. Grant access to orders, products, inventory, and fulfillment.
jtl_setup_help_onprem: Register Luma as an app in JTL-Wawi, then enter its token and challenge code. Your Luma administrator must allow connections to this API address.
jtl_setup_read_access: Luma requests read access to orders, products, inventory, and fulfillment. After you save, validate access to see what JTL grants.
jtl_setup_shipping_write: Allow shipping method corrections. Requires read and write access to sales orders in JTL.
jtl_setup_purchasing: Allow sending approved purchase orders. Requires access to suppliers, purchase orders, and items in JTL.
jtl_setup_returns: Allow creating approved returns for return cases. Requires access to sales orders, warehouses, and returns in JTL.
jtl_setup_customers: Import customers, including names, contact details, and addresses, and link them to their orders. Requires read access to customers in JTL.
jtl_setup_uncertain: Luma couldn’t confirm whether this was saved. Close this form and refresh the list before you try again.
jtl_setup_exchanges: Read exchange replacement orders and reservations. Requires sales-order and inventory access in JTL.
